vi.main: Tong quan phat hanh san sang
vi.sub: Tin hieu chinh da dong nhat

zh.sub: 主决策为 GO，来源可信，一致性正常，当前可按标准流程推进发布。

en.sub: Core decision is GO, source is trusted, and consistency is healthy, so release can proceed by standard flow.

vi.sub: Quyet dinh chinh la GO, nguon tin cay va tinh nhat quan binh thuong, co the tiep tuc theo quy trinh chuan.

firstAction.zh: 先确认发布窗口，再执行正式放行并同步值班结论。
firstAction.en: Confirm release window first, then execute formal release and sync the duty conclusion.
firstAction.vi: Xac nhan cua so phat hanh truoc, sau do phat hanh chinh thuc va dong bo ket luan truc.

sourceSubcopy.zh: source 正常且 generatedAt 存在，来源链路可用于当前值班判断。
sourceSubcopy.en: Source is valid and generatedAt is present, so the source chain is usable for duty judgment.
sourceSubcopy.vi: Source hop le va generatedAt ton tai, nen co the dung chuoi nguon cho phan doan truc.

consistencySubcopy.zh: consistencyOk=true，release-ready 与 consistency 口径未见冲突。
consistencySubcopy.en: consistencyOk=true, so release-ready and consistency signals are not conflicting.
consistencySubcopy.vi: consistencyOk=true, nen release-ready va tin hieu consistency khong xung dot.

vi.main: Tong quan phat hanh bi chan
vi.sub: Khong duoc phat hanh luc nay

zh.sub: 当前存在阻断信号，或一致性未通过，必须先停发再复核。

en.sub: There is a blocking signal or failed consistency, so release must be held before review.

vi.sub: Dang co tin hieu chan hoac consistency that bai, can tam dung phat hanh truoc khi ra soat.

firstAction.zh: 先处理首个 reason 或一致性冲突，再重跑 latest-check 与 consistency 校验。
firstAction.en: Resolve the first reason or consistency conflict first, then rerun latest-check and consistency validation.
firstAction.vi: Xu ly reason dau tien hoac xung dot consistency truoc, sau do chay lai latest-check va kiem tra consistency.

sourceSubcopy.zh: 即使 source 正常，阻断信号仍优先；若 source 异常，待阻断项清零后再补复核。
sourceSubcopy.en: Even with a normal source, blockers still take priority; if source is abnormal, review it after blockers are cleared.
sourceSubcopy.vi: Ngay ca khi source binh thuong, blocker van uu tien; neu source bat thuong, hay ra soat sau khi da xu ly blocker.

consistencySubcopy.zh: consistencyOk=false 时按高风险处理，禁止依据单一卡片直接对外放行。
consistencySubcopy.en: When consistencyOk=false, treat it as high risk and do not release based on a single card.
consistencySubcopy.vi: Khi consistencyOk=false, can xem la rui ro cao va khong duoc phat hanh chi dua tren mot the duy nhat.

conditions: source missing OR source not_in ['live','latest_file','sync_latest','canonical','release_ready_latest'] OR generatedAt is missing OR generatedAt == ''

vi.main: Tong quan phat hanh can ra soat
vi.sub: Can xac nhan nguon hoac moc thoi gian

zh.sub: 主决策为 GO 且一致性正常，但来源字段或时间戳不足以支持直接发布，需人工复核。

en.sub: Core decision is GO and consistency is fine, but source field or timestamp is not strong enough for direct release.

vi.sub: Quyet dinh chinh la GO va consistency binh thuong, nhung truong nguon hoac moc thoi gian chua du de phat hanh truc tiep.

firstAction.zh: 先核对 source 与 generatedAt，再决定是否进入正式放行。
firstAction.en: Verify source and generatedAt first, then decide whether to enter formal release.
firstAction.vi: Kiem tra source va generatedAt truoc, sau do moi quyet dinh co vao buoc phat hanh chinh thuc hay khong.

sourceSubcopy.zh: source 异常或 generatedAt 缺失更像证据不足，不等于系统故障。
sourceSubcopy.en: Abnormal source or missing generatedAt usually means insufficient evidence, not necessarily a system fault.
sourceSubcopy.vi: Source bat thuong hoac thieu generatedAt thuong la do bang chung chua du, khong nhat thiet la loi he thong.

consistencySubcopy.zh: consistencyOk=true 仅表示口径一致，不能替代 source/generatedAt 的复核。
consistencySubcopy.en: consistencyOk=true only means the signals agree; it does not replace source/generatedAt review.
consistencySubcopy.vi: consistencyOk=true chi co nghia la cac tin hieu dong nhat; no khong the thay the viec ra soat source/generatedAt.
